units.source_text: 风突然平静，复又强劲起来。

en.t: The wind suddenly fell calm, then grew strong again.

units.source_text: 森林敏感地竖起耳朵倾听，忽而沉寂，忽而喧嚣。

en.t: The forest, sensitive, pricked up its ears and listened, now falling silent, now growing noisy.

units.source_text: 地面上的月影也随之忽暗忽明，迅速地一扫而过。

en.t: The moon shadows on the ground also dimmed and brightened with it, swiftly sweeping past.
